title: Reconcile source and provenance locators after multi-page fixes
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT found top-level source strings still inconsistent with provenance.locator for many records, often showing only the start page.
- Fable P4 observed start-page-only locators such as feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations citing p. 47 even though text spans pp. 47-50; Fable verified no text loss in the wider window.
- This is residual after closed provenance work, so create a new bead rather than assuming the closed bead covers it.

Examples to verify:
- feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations
- feature:druid:wild-shape
- feature:sorcerer:font-of-magic
- spell:scrying
- rule:half-dragon-template
- rule:hit-points
- equipment:crystal

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide and document whether top-level source should mirror provenance.locator or remain a legacy start-page display field.
- If it should mirror, update generation and tests.
- If it should not mirror, ensure retrieval/citation uses provenance.locator and audit output explains the distinction.
- Verify the concrete examples and add regression coverage for multi-page records.
close_reason: Updated SRD provenance enrichment so widened provenance locators also widen SRD 5.1 display source labels; regenerated records; added committed-pack regression coverage for source/locator alignment and the bead examples.
